observations: Photo 0 shows a black console standing vertically next to a black controller.
The console has a vertical slot for disc insertion and a power button with a small light.
The side of the console clearly shows 'XBOX 360' in white text.
The controller has the standard Xbox 360 layout: D-pad, two analog sticks, four colored face buttons (red, green, blue, yellow), and the central Xbox guide button.
Both the console and controller show visible signs of wear: scuffs, smudges, and dirt, especially on the controller.
The console appears to be the original Xbox 360 model (not the S or E version), based on its size and design.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI AKANNIGAMES' overlaid on the image.
